title: The residues of OEIS A370092 modulo k have period dividing phi(k): a proof of a conjecture of Bala
description: The sequence A370092 is defined by a(0) = 1 and a(n) = (-1)^n + (1/2) sum_{j=1..n} (1 - (-1)^j - (-2)^j) C(n,j) a(n-j); its exponential generating function is 2e^x/(1 + e^x + e^{2x} - e^{3x}). Peter Bala conjectured that for every k > 2 the sequence a(n) mod k is eventually periodic with period dividing phi(k). We prove that a(n + phi(k)) = a(n) mod k for all k >= 3 and n >= k, and that the period modulo 2^e is exactly 2^(e-1). Known results for e.g.f.s G(e^x - 1) with integral G do not apply, since here G has denominators 2^{floor(k/3)}; the key step is a 2-section of the generating function in e^x. The proof is formalized in Lean 4 with Mathlib against the statement OeisA370092.bounds of Google DeepMind's Formal Conjectures repository. The repository contains the paper (LaTeX source and PDF), the Lean files, a check script, exact-arithmetic checks and logs.
